steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I was just thinking when you'd come through this door again... Speak of the devil.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Who did you hear from this time?

options: The investigation is done. I asked everyone on the street.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm really exhausted. Can I lie on the couch for a bit? I'll leave right away if any customers come. I won't disturb your business...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Don't worry. It's a foggy day so not many people dare to go out. I'm quite free right now.
You dodder over to the couch in the waiting area and collapse onto it.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: But since you're so tired, why didn't you go home and get a full night's sleep? Did you forget the key?
You take out the spare key and wave it in front of her.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The best place is where you are. Chatting with you is really relaxing.
You hear her chuckle lightly.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Thank you for your kind feedback. It's my pleasure to listen to you. Here, have some black tea. Careful, it's hot.
As she speaks, she hands you a cup of freshly brewed black tea.
The warm aroma of tea blends with her unique fragrance, soothing your jumbled mind. Now you can rearrange the information obtained from your investigation.

options: The monster are somehow connected to several townspeople.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...A girl with an ill-stricken mother, a workaholic salaryman, a shy boy who avoids his lover, and a former Syndican who hides her identity... The items dropped by the monsters all represent their worries.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: These aren't coincidences. The townspeople's <color=#fb9259>worries</color> have turned into monsters wrapped in hair, which continue to haunt their owners. This is the truth about the monsters.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: You mean, things that only existed in people's minds have become reality?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Mmm... like in novels?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Adela, have you heard of Mania?
She shakes her head.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It has been spreading in West District for a long time, and is now affecting Eastside. In essence, it's the concretization of human spiritual energy, along with all the mutations it triggers.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It's undoubtedly responsible for the fog that blocked off the street and the hair monsters inside—anything that defies the laws of science can be chalked up to Mania. After all, reality has been distorted.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Mania is very dangerous. You should stay away from it. If you encounter anything that might seem like Mania, call the police right away.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Hehe, you sure know a lot, Inspector. Even after losing your memory, your mind is still working quite well.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I got entangled by those weird things in the street before. How should I put it... I seem to have some sort of special connection with them. Whenever I see them, I remember bits and pieces.
You're referring to the bits and pieces of information that you vaguely recall after encountering the strange "shadow people".
But having said that, the fog and Mad Shears have been around for a long time, yet the hair monsters only started appearing yesterday. If you're not mistaken, the Mania here is increasing.
The culprit of all this is...

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Just as I thought, you have my shears. You stole them from me. You freed yourself, but what about me?!

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Where'd you hide it? Where'd you hide it?
Did Mad Shears grow stronger all of a sudden? Or did something affect it, making it lose control? You can't tell.
The mystery of the foggy night is linked to Mad Shears, while the mystery of Mad Shears is linked to...

options: The night you lost your memory.

steps.content: <size=31>That night, deep in that foggy alley behind the clock tower, something must have happened between you and Mad Shears that resulted in this series of upheavals. As for what it did to you, and what happened to it... you can only find out by going back to the scene.</size>
...But in your current state, the risk is simply too great.

You hear the light clinking of porcelain. You look up to see Adela putting a cup of freshly brewed black tea before you. Only then did you realize that you had been silently lost in your own thoughts for a long time.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Are you that worried? The tea has gotten cold. Let me pour you a new cup.
You hurriedly thank her and take the cup. This time, the temperature is just right. You take a sip and relax a little. Adela looks at you smilingly the whole time.
What an incredible woman. It must be extremely dangerous for a frail person like her to venture out alone in the middle of the night, but you never saw her lose her cool.
In these two short days, her calming aura has become something you rely on.

options: Are you worried about anything, Adela?

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Why do you ask that?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: That fellow seems to be constantly chasing people's worries. Whether it created them in the first place, or is just trying to rob the energy from them, people's worries are all its prey.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I don't want you to get hurt.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...Thank you. Don't worry, nothing's worrying me.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Because of this job, many people like to tell me their worries.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Neighbors and customers alike... Everyone is bound to encounter dilemmas and troubles that are unresolvable and hard to shake off.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I know exactly what it's like to feel worried, but I don't feel that way myself.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I moved many times before finally finding this place—a little home where I can sleep peacefully, a job that I can excel at, and the opportunity to gain trust and give back. Every problem has its solution.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: Every moment of my life brings me peace and stability. There's nothing that I can't bear or want to get rid of. I cherish these peaceful times and hope they can last forever.

options: Then I must be the one giving you worries, no?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I suddenly crashed into your life, forcing you to take care of me.
She smiles, amused.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I've always loved taking care of people. If my "service" can alleviate worries and bring about a happy smile, it's all worth it.

options: You've done a great job already.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: This cup of black tea alone cheered me up. I don't feel so depressed when I think of other things now.
You smile and toast her in thanks. She looks at you in silence for a long time, then speaks up.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I really like you.
You almost spit out your tea, yet Adela's expression remains unchanged. She didn't seem to mean anything special, and continues to talk calmly.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I want to thank Mad Shears for making us meet. It took away your worries, while you gave me a great time.

options: Thank it for taking away my worries...?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I can't bring myself to thank it. I really want to know what my "worries" were.
For example, those two little things that keep bugging you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Maybe not all of them are worries that can't be shaken off. Maybe some of those worries are actually, um... precious things that I can't let go of no matter how worrisome they are.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Besides, Mad Shears is just a bandit who robbed me of my memories. The kind soul who really offloaded my worries is a gentle hairdresser. You're the one I should thank, Adela.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...I'm honored. Although...
Before she can finish her sentence, a string of screams ring out from outside.
You jump up from the couch and run to the window to look towards the square.

You can't see a thing. The thick fog has blanketed the entire street. Eerie shadows run amok—maybe they're frightened residents, maybe they're monsters, or maybe it's Mad Shears... The situation has really deteriorated.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm going back to the alley to find the truth and stop Mad Shears. You stay here. I'll come pick you up when it's all over.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: It will probably try to attack you again.
There's a hint of worry in her voice.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Didn't you say that I've beaten it before? That I'm very strong?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Plus, just like you've done so much for me, I want to give back to you. I will solve this mystery and restore peace to the town.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm leaving now. Maybe I can resolve everything quickly and come meet you when you get off work.
Adela looks at you silently for a long time before speaking up again.

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: ...All right. Please be careful.
You leave her little salon, shutting the door behind you. You're confronted by thick fog, and strange noises echoing from inside it.

The thick fog rolls and surges. The uninvited guests in the fog approach to the tune of the chiming clock. Sure enough, things have gotten worse, and you aren't quite sure if you can defend yourself. However...

steps.speaker: Adela
steps.content: I cherish these peaceful times and hope they can last forever.
...You can't let it run loose any longer.
